headline: I'm still working. What's blocking the money I should have by now?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing MONEY_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see the picture, and your hand still found the worker of the three.
Look at both hands. They are working above a table where every tool is out.
You asked what blocks the money you should have by now while you are still working. The busy hands are the part I cannot ignore.
And yet you are still working, and the money you expected has not arrived.
I keep coming back to something between the work and the result. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding the result…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The backs were identical, but you reached for the one held at a single point.
One rope holds one ankle. Nothing else on him is tied.
You asked why the money is still blocked. This card brings me to the one point doing the holding.
Still, the result remains held while the work continues.
Something is holding the money hard. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what that obstruction is…
c: You turned the Fool. The card was hidden, yet your hand went to the one in full light.
The full sun is high behind him.
You asked about money that should have come by now. The full light on this card holds my eye.
But the money has not moved with the work, and “by now” is already in your question.
Something turns up just where the work should become the result. I don't think it started with you.
Now let's look at what's behind it…
